local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Find F3X SyncAPI
local tool

for _, v in player:GetDescendants() do
	if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then
		tool = v.Parent
	end
end

for _, v in game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants() do
	if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then
		tool = v.Parent
	end
end

local remote = tool
	and tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI")
	and tool.SyncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint")

local function remoteExecute(args)
	if remote then
		remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
	end
end

local function SetCollision(part, boolean)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncCollision",
		{
			{
				Part = part,
				CanCollide = boolean
			}
		}
	})
end

local function CreatePart(cf, parent)
	remoteExecute({
		"CreatePart",
		"Normal",
		cf,
		parent
	})
end

local function Resize(part, size, cf)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncResize",
		{
			{
				Part = part,
				CFrame = cf,
				Size = size
			}
		}
	})
end

local function AddMesh(part)
	remoteExecute({
		"CreateMeshes",
		{
			{
				Part = part
			}
		}
	})
end

local function SetMesh(part, meshid)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncMesh",
		{
			{
				Part = part,
				MeshId = "rbxassetid://" .. meshid
			}
		}
	})
end

local function SetName(part, name)
	remoteExecute({
		"SetName",
		{ part },
		name
	})
end

local function SetLocked(part, boolean)
	remoteExecute({
		"SetLocked",
		{ part },
		boolean
	})
end

local function SetTrans(part, transparency)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncMaterial",
		{
			{
				Part = part,
				Transparency = transparency
			}
		}
	})
end

local function Color(part, color)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncColor",
		{
			{
				Part = part,
				Color = color,
				UnionColoring = false
			}
		}
	})
end

-- Hide the original character
if char:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
	pcall(function()
		SetTrans(char["Right Arm"], 1)
		SetTrans(char["Left Arm"], 1)
		SetTrans(char["Torso"], 1)
		SetTrans(char["Left Leg"], 1)
		SetTrans(char["Right Leg"], 1)
		SetTrans(char["Head"], 1)
	end)

	-- Create reanimation parts
	local partNames = {
		"Right Arm FE",
		"Left Arm FE",
		"Right Leg FE",
		"Left Leg FE",
		"Head FE",
		"Torso FE"
	}

	for _, name in ipairs(partNames) do
		CreatePart(
			rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0),
			char.Torso
		)

		local newPart = char.Torso:WaitForChild("Part", 2)

		if newPart then
			SetCollision(newPart, false)

			Resize(
				newPart,
				Vector3.new(0.9, 1.9, 0.9),
				rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
			)

			SetName(newPart, name)
		end
	end

	-- Apply character meshes
	pcall(function()
		local head = char.Torso:WaitForChild("Head FE")
		local torso = char.Torso:WaitForChild("Torso FE")

		AddMesh(head)
		SetMesh(head, "6571349341")

		AddMesh(torso)
		SetMesh(torso, "12800536037")

		for _, limbName in ipairs({
			"Left Leg FE",
			"Right Leg FE",
			"Right Arm FE",
			"Left Arm FE"
		}) do
			local limb = char.Torso:WaitForChild(limbName)

			AddMesh(limb)
			SetMesh(limb, "127739625807358")
		end

		-- Colors
		Color(head, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
		Color(torso, Color3.fromRGB(180, 210, 228))

		Color(
			char.Torso:WaitForChild("Right Arm FE"),
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		)

		Color(
			char.Torso:WaitForChild("Left Arm FE"),
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		)

		Color(
			char.Torso:WaitForChild("Right Leg FE"),
			Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		)

		Color(
			char.Torso:WaitForChild("Left Leg FE"),
			Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		)

		-- Lock reanimation parts
		for _, name in ipairs(partNames) do
			local part = char.Torso:FindFirstChild(name)

			if part then
				SetLocked(part, true)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Reanimation follow
	local animTick = 0

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		pcall(function()
			local rightArmFE = char.Torso:FindFirstChild("Right Arm FE")
			local leftArmFE = char.Torso:FindFirstChild("Left Arm FE")
			local leftLegFE = char.Torso:FindFirstChild("Left Leg FE")
			local rightLegFE = char.Torso:FindFirstChild("Right Leg FE")
			local headFE = char.Torso:FindFirstChild("Head FE")
			local torsoFE = char.Torso:FindFirstChild("Torso FE")

			local function smoothFollow(fePart, realPart, targetCF)
				if fePart and realPart then
					local goalCF = targetCF or realPart.CFrame
					local lerpedCF = fePart.CFrame:Lerp(goalCF, 0.4)

					Resize(
						fePart,
						Vector3.new(0.01, 0.01, 0.01),
						lerpedCF
					)
				end
			end

			local speed = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
			local isMoving = speed > 0.5

			if not isMoving then
				animTick += dt * 2

				local bob = math.sin(animTick) * 0.03

				smoothFollow(
					rightArmFE,
					char["Right Arm"],
					char["Right Arm"].CFrame * CFrame.new(0, bob, 0)
				)

				smoothFollow(
					leftArmFE,
					char["Left Arm"],
					char["Left Arm"].CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -bob, 0)
				)

				smoothFollow(
					leftLegFE,
					char["Left Leg"],
					char["Left Leg"].CFrame
				)

				smoothFollow(
					rightLegFE,
					char["Right Leg"],
					char["Right Leg"].CFrame
				)

				smoothFollow(
					headFE,
					char["Head"],
					char["Head"].CFrame * CFrame.new(0, bob * 0.5, 0)
				)

				smoothFollow(
					torsoFE,
					char["Torso"],
					char["Torso"].CFrame * CFrame.new(0, bob, 0)
				)
			else
				animTick += dt * 8

				local swing = math.sin(animTick) * 0.15

				smoothFollow(
					rightArmFE,
					char["Right Arm"],
					char["Right Arm"].CFrame * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0)
				)

				smoothFollow(
					leftArmFE,
					char["Left Arm"],
					char["Left Arm"].CFrame * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0)
				)

				smoothFollow(
					leftLegFE,
					char["Left Leg"],
					char["Left Leg"].CFrame * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0)
				)

				smoothFollow(
					rightLegFE,
					char["Right Leg"],
					char["Right Leg"].CFrame * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0)
				)

				smoothFollow(
					headFE,
					char["Head"]
				)

				smoothFollow(
					torsoFE,
					char["Torso"]
				)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function safeDownload(filename, url)
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)

	if success and type(data) == "string" and #data > 100 then
		writefile(filename, data)
		print("Downloaded:", filename)
	else
		warn("Failed to download:", filename)
	end
end

if not isfile("Gojo.rbxmx") then

--========================================================
--  SERVICES & PLAYER
--========================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--========================================================
--  F3X SYNC HELPERS
--========================================================
local function getSyncAPI()
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		local bt = char:FindFirstChild("Building Tools")
		if bt and bt:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then
			return bt.SyncAPI
		end
	end
	for _, v in ipairs(player:GetDescendants()) do
		if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then return v end
	end
	for _, v in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
		if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then return v end
	end
	return nil
end

local function remoteExecute(args)
	local api = getSyncAPI()
	if api then
		pcall(function()
			api:Invoke(unpack(args))
		end)
	end
end

local function CreatePart(shape, cf, parent)
	remoteExecute({
		"CreatePart",
		shape or "Normal",
		cf,
		parent or workspace
	})
end

local function Resize(part, size, cf)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncResize",
		{{Part = part, CFrame = cf, Size = size}}
	})
end

local function SetCollision(part, bool)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncCollision",
		{{Part = part, CanCollide = bool}}
	})
end

local function Color(part, col)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncColor",
		{{Part = part, Color = col, UnionColoring = false}}
	})
end

local function SetName(part, name)
	remoteExecute({"SetName", {part}, name})
end

local function SetLocked(part, bool)
	remoteExecute({"SetLocked", {part}, bool})
end

local function SetTrans(part, t)
	remoteExecute({
		"SyncMaterial",
		{{Part = part, Transparency = t}}
	})
end

local function SetAnchored(part, anchored)
	if not part or not part.Parent then return end
	local api = getSyncAPI()
	if not api then return end
	local endpoint = api:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint") or api

	pcall(function()
		endpoint:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {part}, false)
	end)
	task.wait(0.03)
	pcall(function()
		endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncAnchor", {
			{
				Part = part,
				Anchored = anchored
			}
		})
	end)
end

local function DeleteParts(...)
	local parts = {...}
	if #parts == 0 then return end

	local api = getSyncAPI()
	if not api then return end
	local endpoint = api:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint") or api

	for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if part and part.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				endpoint:InvokeServer("Remove", {part})
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Kill function from Goner script
local function KillNearby(position, radius)
	local api = getSyncAPI()
	if not api then return end
	local endpoint = api:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint") or api

	local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, radius)
	for _, p in pairs(parts) do
		local model = p.Parent
		if model:IsA("Model") and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and model ~= player.Character then
			local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if head then
				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(function()
						endpoint:InvokeServer("Remove", {head})
					end)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function CreateSyncedSphere(cf, size, color, name)
	local oldParts = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			oldParts[p] = true
		end
	end

	CreatePart("Ball", cf, workspace)

	local part = nil
	for i = 1, 30 do
		for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and not oldParts[p] then
				part = p
				break
			end
		end
		if part then break end
		task.wait(0.03)
	end

	if not part then
		warn("Failed to create Ball")
		return nil
	end

	SetName(part, name or "SyncedOrb")
	SetCollision(part, false)
	Resize(part, size, cf)
	Color(part, color)
	SetLocked(part, true)

	return part
end

--========================================================
--  KEYFRAME PLAYER
--========================================================
local EasingStyleMap = {
	[Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Linear]   = Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
	[Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Bounce]   = Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce,
	[Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Cubic]    = Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic,
	[Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Elastic]  = Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic,
	[Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Constant] = Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
}
local EasingDirectionMap = {
	[Enum.PoseEasingDirection.In]    = Enum.EasingDirection.In,
	[Enum.PoseEasingDirection.Out]   = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
	[Enum.PoseEasingDirection.InOut] = Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
}

local function PlayKeyframeSequence(Model, KeyframeSequence, SpeedMult)
	SpeedMult = SpeedMult or 1
	local keyframes = {}
	for _, kf in ipairs(KeyframeSequence:GetKeyframes()) do
		table.insert(keyframes, {Time = kf.Time, KF = kf})
	end
	table.sort(keyframes, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	if #keyframes == 0 then return nil end

	local jointData = {}
	local motorMap, boneMap = {}, {}

	local function ResolveJoint(pose)
		local name = pose.Name
		if motorMap[name] then return motorMap[name], "Motor6D" end
		if boneMap[name] then return boneMap[name], "Bone" end
		for _, v in ipairs(Model:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("Motor6D") and v.Part1 and v.Part1.Name == name then
				motorMap[name] = v
				return v, "Motor6D"
			elseif v:IsA("Bone") and v.Name == name then
				boneMap[name] = v
				return v, "Bone"
			end
		end
		return nil, nil
	end

	for _, entry in ipairs(keyframes) do
		for _, pose in ipairs(entry.KF:GetDescendants()) do
			if pose:IsA("Pose") and pose.Weight > 0 then
				local joint, jtype = ResolveJoint(pose)
				if joint then
					if not jointData[pose.Name] then jointData[pose.Name] = {} end
					table.insert(jointData[pose.Name], {
						time = entry.Time,
						cframe = pose.CFrame,
						style = pose.EasingStyle,
						dir = pose.EasingDirection,
						joint = joint,
						jtype = jtype
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local totalLength = keyframes[#keyframes].Time / SpeedMult
	local isPlaying = true
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local connection

	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not isPlaying or not Model or not Model.Parent then
			if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
			return
		end
		local elapsed = (os.clock() - startTime) * SpeedMult
		local timePos = elapsed % totalLength

		for _, poses in pairs(jointData) do
			if #poses < 1 then continue end
			local lastPose, nextPose = poses[1], poses[1]
			for i = 1, #poses - 1 do
				if timePos >= poses[i].time and timePos < poses[i + 1].time then
					lastPose = poses[i]
					nextPose = poses[i + 1]
					break
				end
			end
			if timePos >= poses[#poses].time then
				lastPose = poses[#poses]
				nextPose = poses[#poses]
			end

			local alpha = 0
			if nextPose.time > lastPose.time then
				alpha = (timePos - lastPose.time) / (nextPose.time - lastPose.time)
			end
			local style = EasingStyleMap[nextPose.style] or Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
			local dir = EasingDirectionMap[nextPose.dir] or Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
			local eased = TweenService:GetValue(alpha, style, dir)
			lastPose.joint.Transform = lastPose.cframe:Lerp(nextPose.cframe, eased)
		end
	end)

	return {
		Length = totalLength,
		Stop = function()
			isPlaying = false
			if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
		end,
		Play = function()
			startTime = os.clock()
		end
	}
end

--========================================================
--  CREATE THE 4 ATTACK TOOLS
--========================================================
function createAttackTools()

	--==================== HOLLOW PURPLE ====================
	local hpTool = Instance.new("Tool")
	hpTool.Name = "Hollow Purple"
	hpTool.RequiresHandle = false
	hpTool.Parent = player.Backpack

	hpTool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then return end
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		local originalSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
		local originalAnimator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if originalAnimator then originalAnimator.Parent = nil end
		hum.WalkSpeed = 0

		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.SoundId = getcustomasset("Purple.mp3")
		sound.Volume = 1
		sound.Parent = workspace
		sound:Play()

		local purpleAnim = Anims:FindFirstChild("Purple")
		local animPlayer = purpleAnim and PlayKeyframeSequence(char, purpleAnim, 0.59)
		if animPlayer then animPlayer.Play() end

		local blueOrb = CreateSyncedSphere(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(-5, 0, 8), Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255), "BlueOrb")
		local blueConn
		if blueOrb then
			blueConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if not blueOrb or not blueOrb.Parent then
					if blueConn then blueConn:Disconnect() end
					return
				end
				Resize(blueOrb, Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), root.CFrame * CFrame.new(-5, 0, 8))
			end)
		end

		task.wait(4)

		local redOrb = CreateSyncedSphere(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(5, 0, 8), Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40), "RedOrb")
		local redConn
		if redOrb then
			redConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if not redOrb or not redOrb.Parent then
					if redConn then redConn:Disconnect() end
